name: o3-mini
description: Cost-effective reasoning model optimized for STEM tasks.
longDescription: o3-mini is a smaller, cost-optimized version of o3 that still delivers strong reasoning capabilities, particularly in STEM domains. It offers adjustable reasoning effort levels (low, medium, high) to balance cost and performance.
strengths: Strong STEM reasoning at lower cost

import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="o3-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
